idea: The subtraction condition gives m = n + 2. If n is below 16 or above 16, monotonicity of multiplication contradicts m * n = 288, so n = 16 and m = 18.
proof:
have hnm : n ≤ m := by
    by_contra h
    have hz : m - n = 0 := Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le (Nat.le_of_not_ge h)
    rw [hz] at h₂
    norm_num at h₂
  have heq : m = n + 2 := by
    simpa [h₂, Nat.add_comm] using (Nat.sub_add_cancel hnm).symm
  have hn : n = 16 := by
    have hlo : 16 ≤ n := by
      by_contra h
      have hn' : n ≤ 15 := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Nat.lt_of_not_ge h)
      have hm' : m ≤ 17 := by
        rw [heq]
        simpa using Nat.add_le_add_right hn' 2
      have hp : m * n ≤ 255 := by
        simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul hm' hn'
      linarith
    have hhi : n ≤ 16 := by
      by_contra h
      have hn' : 17 ≤ n := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_not_ge h)
      have hm' : 19 ≤ m := by
        rw [heq]
        simpa using Nat.add_le_add_right hn' 2
      have hp : 323 ≤ m * n := by
        simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul hm' hn'
      linarith
    exact Nat.le_antisymm hhi hlo
  simpa [hn] using heq
